beats.say: Dimitris Papailiopoulos had coding agents write small modules such as a calculator, rule checkers, a mistake detector and image 'eyes' directly into Qwen3-0.6B's weights; switched on, they lift BIG-Bench Hard from 41% to 55% without RL.
Implants stay off until needed, so the base model is bit-for-bit unchanged until one fires.
The work builds on the 2023 Looped Transformers as Programmable Computers paper, and code is open source.
